scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names auth,backend,frontend "npm run auth" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend-dev"
scripts.frontend-dev: cd frontend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && cd .. && bash ./backend/scripts/wait-for-backend.sh && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.frontend-build: cd frontend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
